dvids.title: CENTCOM Maintains Strict Enforcement of U.S. Blockade Against Iran
dvids.desc: TAMPA, Fla. — On Oct. 5, U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces redirected the 130th commercial vessel in the Middle East during strict enforcement of the ongoing U.S. naval blockade against Iran.

dvids.title: Nevada Air Guardsmen return from historic deployment supporting Operation Epic Fury
dvids.desc: Six months after a one-week notice federal callup, Nevada Air National Guardsmen and four C-130 aircraft returned home Sunday from deployment to the U.S. Central Command area of responsibility in support of Operation Epic Fury.
